Do not force the browser dictionary to exactly 21 codes. Do not resurrect validation_error, access_denied, authentication_required, pilot_text_ai_consent_required, or not_eligible_or_already_purged as duplicate display codes.
verification: Use LSP references before changing exported symbols when available.
Run only the directly affected error and record-review tests plus the smallest existing browser smoke covering the repaired recovery rendering; do not run project-wide suites, linters, or formatters.
Commit only the allowed explicit paths locally. Do not push, merge, deploy, or contact external services.
report: At completion print the marker, commit SHA, changed paths, exact verification counts, and any blocker.
